themes_detail.label: Obstruction spike in public spaces
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints in Forest Hills/Rego Park surged to 8 complaints THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 1.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 611% increase (z-score: 7.42)—suggesting a sudden, acute blockage problem affecting sidewalks, streets, or transit access.
evidence: 8 obstruction complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (611% spike)
Z-score of 7.42 indicates statistically extreme deviation from baseline
No Reddit or community board discussions yet logged, suggesting story is breaking now
reporting_angles: What specific obstructions are blocking sidewalks/streets this week? (illegally parked vehicles, construction debris, vendor encroachments)
Are multiple neighborhoods affected or is this localized to one commercial corridor (Queens Blvd, Yellowstone Blvd)?

themes_detail.label: Smoking/vaping complaints triple
themes_detail.summary: Smoking or vaping complaints jumped to 9 complaints THIS WEEK compared to a baseline of 1.1 per week—a 700% increase (z-score: 6.21)—pointing to a new pattern of indoor or public smoking violations in residential or commercial spaces.
evidence: 9 smoking/vaping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike)
Z-score of 6.21 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Timing coincides with Obstruction and Real Time Enforcement spikes, suggesting possible enforcement activity or venue change
reporting_angles: Is a specific venue (bar, restaurant, vape shop) newly operating or has enforcement changed?
Are complaints concentrated in residential buildings or public spaces?

themes_detail.label: Tree health crisis emerging
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints quadrupled to 4 THIS WEEK from a baseline of 0.5 per week (700% increase, z-score: 4.95), and overgrown tree/branch complaints hit 4 THIS WEEK versus 0.8 baseline (433% increase, z-score: 3.92)—indicating acute arboreal damage or neglect across the district.
evidence: Dead/dying trees: 4 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (700% spike, z-score: 4.95)
Overgrown tree/branches: 4 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly baseline (433% spike, z-score: 3.92)
Community board has standing request to 'provide new or expanded park or amenity,' suggesting tree/green space maintenance is chronic concern
reporting_angles: Was there recent storm damage, pest infestation, or disease outbreak affecting street trees?
What is Parks Department's tree maintenance budget/staffing in this district vs. citywide?

themes_detail.label: Sewer system stress last week
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints jumped to 14 LAST WEEK versus a baseline of 3.9 per week over 8 weeks—a 261% increase (z-score: 3.8)—suggesting potential blockages, overflow, or infrastructure failure affecting multiple addresses.
evidence: 14 sewer complaints LAST WEEK vs. 3.9 weekly baseline (261% spike, z-score: 3.8)
Community board has standing DEP capital budget request ('Other capital budget request for DEP'), indicating infrastructure is known pain point
Heat/hot water also tops 311 list at 2,009 complaints (90 days), may indicate broader utility infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Were there sewer backups, raw sewage exposure, or related water quality issues in any neighborhoods?
Is DEP conducting work or has there been recent precipitation that overwhelmed aging infrastructure?

themes_detail.label: Real-time enforcement activity surge
themes_detail.summary: Real Time Enforcement complaints spiked to 5 LAST WEEK from a baseline of 0.6 per week—a 700% increase (z-score: 6.29)—suggesting either a new enforcement operation or resident complaints about enforcement tactics in the district.
evidence: 5 Real Time Enforcement complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly baseline (700% spike, z-score: 6.29)
Timing overlaps with Obstruction, Smoking, and SPIT spikes, suggesting possible coordinated enforcement push
SPIT complaints also up 567% last week (5 vs. 0.8 baseline), reinforcing enforcement signal
reporting_angles: Did NYPD launch a new enforcement initiative targeting parking, street vending, or quality-of-life violations?
Are residents experiencing aggressive policing or citation practices, or are complaints about lack of enforcement?
